note: Sean's State Run Checklist v1.1 rules as data, keyed by checklist ID. This is Admin's scorecard and never holds back publishing. The v1.1 profile (lib/control-plane/readiness/checklist-profile.json) is left untouched because its importer rewrites it.

appliesTo.note: A known record only owes its own facts. A matching rule lists the groups or IDs the record owes, less excludeIds. A capture kind with no rule owes every item in its subject kind's groups. Registry bodies owe GOV, PAR and REF, not ENG: ENG measures the app's reactions, privacy, feedback and alert delivery, so it is not an acquisition task per body. Local votes belong to the body's meeting actions, not Congress or state roll calls or federal PRL; a roster can include a mayor, so local officeholders keep EXE. A campaign committee has no public budget and a voting date has no polling location; those stay discovery work for the place, not the record.

freshnessHours.note: Hours a captured field stays fresh, by the kind of source it came from.

lifecycle.note: When a posting-deadline item falls due. Starting values; both are settings. An agenda is due this many hours before its meeting. Minutes, recordings and the other outcome items are due this many days after it. Awaiting publication never removes an item that is already due.

settings.note: Starting values. Squads are a setting: Admin can change which squad takes a family.

replacedByAdmin.GATE-01: The captain's orders for scope replace the frozen manifest.
replacedByAdmin.GATE-13: Admin is the single place orders are given, so one owner controls dispatch.

unit.body: one per body or government body
unit.zip: one per ZIP in the place
unit.rollcall: one per roll call, owed only where roll calls are held

trigger.when-published: only where the government publishes it
trigger.unknown: applicability is unresolved; the item is never dropped

due.now: owed as soon as the place is on a mission

countsAs.row: counted once under its own ID
countsAs.shared: counted once under the ID in `into`
countsAs.summary: a summary whose detail items carry the count; kept out of the denominator

onlyFor.tribal-overlap: only where a tribal overlap is held

kellyFields.note: What makes a profile full, as a measure and never a gate. The union of the design's two lists: portrait, phone and contact, verified page, campaign site, stances, money and votes. Only the fields that apply to a person are counted: campaign site and money only for people with a campaign, votes only for voting members. `ids` names the checklist items that evidence the field for a seat or a candidate; an empty list means that field cannot be joined to the person yet and is reported as not measured, never as missing.
